text:
Kevin Fiala's return is the story, more than anything he has done in five games. Yahoo Sports framed it plainly: he is back in the NHL nine months after a frightening Olympic injury. He has two assists, 17 minutes a night, and the Kings have had a rough time with him on the ice, 40% of the five-on-five expected goals (expected goals measure the quality of chances). Five games after a long layoff tells us almost nothing.

What we know is the player before the injury. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him in the 89th percentile for chances from the dangerous area in front of the net. Evolving-Hockey had him near replacement level last season, but with more expected wins than actual ones, which reads as a finishing problem, not a lack of chances. Los Angeles has scored too little all season, and a healthy Fiala is the most direct fix it has. Our range has him around 40 points. Watch for the first goal.
